name: Tetra Engineering — Duct Burners white paper
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Two duct-burner types (standard round gas burners and linear grid burners), location in the transition duct or between superheater stages; inspection criterion of 2-3 in (5-8 cm) runner sag at midpoint; one improperly installed runner buckled in under 10,000 hours. Evidence: https://www.tetra-eng.com/whitepaper/duct-burners
